cause: A 224MiB anonymous allocation did not force enough originally shared GPAs to be reused. The >=128MiB physical-page overlap check failed rather than accepting aggregate allocation size as evidence.
interpretation: The protocol detached and acknowledged the whole 160MiB original set, but only 12MiB entered the measured anonymous workload. This is insufficient end-to-end reuse coverage, not a reported remap/ACK failure. Raw timings are excluded from formal results.
follow_up: A separately archived stopped memory smoke used a measured safe 400MiB allocation, reused/changed 38,611 original pages (150.82421875MiB), and informed the fixed 400MiB formal workload.
